module: Very old small physics scaling benchmark: for 0 to 8 vehicles, measures the average time per update over 1000 frames and writes the result to `phys-scale.csv` (columns "vehicle count;delay"). Defines the globals `testStep` and `benchPhysics`.
notes: Obsolete code: it calls `spawnObjects(i)` and `updateLoop(frames)`, which are defined nowhere in this file or in the console VM; it does not work as is.
Uses globals without `local` (frames, hp, file, d) and the engine class HighPerfTimer.

testStep.desc: Spawns i vehicles, plays 1000 frames and returns the average time per frame in ms (t / frames).

returns.desc: Average time per update, in ms.

benchPhysics.desc: Loop from 0 to 8 vehicles, calls testStep and writes phys-scale.csv; prints "Benchmark running: ... done!".
